summary: Verde Resources, Inc. filed an 8-K to disclose a Master Commercialization and Collaboration Agreement between its subsidiary Verde Renewables and Ergon Asphalt Emulsions. Verde Renewables will act as a preferred supplier of engineered biochar for Ergon's products, including a cold mix road paving product, and will manage carbon credit monetization. The agreement includes good-faith purchase discussions starting 2027 and revenue sharing from carbon credits. No financial terms, stake, or premium are stated. This is a routine commercial supply and collaboration agreement, not a special situation transaction.
